case: A quad whose base colour is demi.exr, a 2 × 2 OpenEXR in four-channel half float, compiled by the shared harness.
rule: A float texture fails no compilation and is never cut down to eight bits: its chain is kept in floating point and held in the half-float atlas — the tail in the previews' pixel file, eight bytes a texel, held by no block family; the levels above the tail, when the image is wider than the tail, as rgba16f files — and no gate or block codec touches it.
